title: Hyderabad beats Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru on clean-air efforts

slides.head: Hyderabad beats Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru on clean-air efforts
What happened
slides.body: Hyderabad scored 174.2 of 200 in the CPCB's Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026 and ranked 19th among million-plus cities.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The survey scores how civic bodies tackle road dust, construction waste, vehicle and industrial pollution, and garbage.

slides.head: Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026 score
slides.body: Among all India's 10-lakh-plus cities, though, it ranks only 19th, up three places.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Greater Hyderabad was also named Telangana's first Swachh city in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: How many of the NCAP-funded electric buses and EV charging stations actually roll out. Ask: Which parts of the city drag the score down: dust, traffic or waste burning?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news
